_note: PUBLIC curated questions for the scaled context-algorithm benchmark. These are the DISCRIMINATING set: conceptual/paraphrase questions where retrieval (esp. semantic vs lexical) should start to differ, unlike the auto identifier questions which everything answers. Schema matches compare_algorithms_scaled.py: each question needs project (must match a --repos name), q, facts (ground-truth strings that MUST appear verbatim in the repo so the presence gate passes), category.
_how_to_use: Run the repo(s) with --repos <name>:<path>, then pass this file via --curated curated_questions.json. Only questions whose project matches a loaded repo AND whose facts appear in that corpus are scored.
_oracle_gate: YOU (Pupa) verify each fact string is (a) correct and (b) present verbatim in the repo. Do not ship a fact you have not confirmed appears in the code. Rule 2: measured/verifiable only.
_categories: conceptual = needs understanding not string-match; paraphrase = question wording differs from code wording; identifier = exact symbol (contrast/control).

questions.q: How does the library decide whether to reuse an existing TCP connection for a new request?
What object holds cookies, auth, and default headers so they persist across multiple requests?
Where is a failed HTTP status turned into a raised exception?
What is the exception raised when a request exceeds the allotted time?
Which component follows redirects and rebuilds the request for the new location?
What holds the fully-built request (method, url, headers, body) just before it is sent?
What object represents a single CLI command that can be invoked?
What groups multiple sub-commands under one parent command?
What carries invocation state (params, parent, object) down through nested commands?
What function prints to the terminal handling encoding and color stripping?
What is the class name for a command-line option?
Which function formats a string of source code and returns the reformatted string?
What tracks blank lines to enforce spacing rules between definitions?
What object holds the formatting configuration such as line length and target versions?
What is the class representing a single logical line of output?
